ofac_comprehensive.note: Whole-country embargoes only. Crimea, Donetsk and Luhansk are regions, not countries. Russia, Belarus, Myanmar and Yemen are list-based programs, so they are NOT here.

fatf_call_for_action.note: Iran and Myanmar confirmed from search snippets of the October 2026 statement. North Korea is listed in the June 2026 statement and not confirmed for October. Re-check on the FATF site.

broad_sanctions.note: Not whole-country embargoes, but US, EU and UK sanctions cover most banking, energy and technology trade. Treated as out by default; reinstate with a reason if you have a legal route.
